skill_name: Based on the following article, summarize the seven benefits of learning a second language.
workflow: Learning a second language can offer a variety of benefits. On an individual level, those who are multilingual may have better opportunities in the workplace and be more creative thinkers and better problem solvers. On a community level, learning a second language has proven to be beneficial in connecting with others, increasing tolerance, and developing empathy.
